skill.summary: Use when the user is working inside an Obsidian or markdown vault and wants to ingest sources, query accumulated knowledge, or maintain a Karpathy-style LLM...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Major simplification: removed all bootstrap scripts, build scripts, and reference guides to leave only the core LLM wiki pattern and philosophy.
- Now uses the original Karpathy LLM Wiki gist as the starting schema; tooling, folder structure, and workflows are to be co-evolved with the user, not imposed.
- Instructions updated: apply this pattern when the user works inside a markdown or Obsidian vault and wants to ingest, query, or maintain an LLM-powered wiki.
- No more required directory layouts, required dependencies, or predefined scripts—integration is now user-driven and minimal by default.
